reason: B is better supported because it combines creep evidence from the exact WTaTiVZr composition with prior edge-dislocation observations in a related BCC refractory HEA, and it proposes grain-size-matched, pre-cracked mechanical comparisons. Both proposals incompletely isolate lattice distortion from composition and contain tension between increased glide barriers and enhanced mobility, but B provides the stronger, more testable mechanistic extension.
